description: Read-only. Accepts a whole bare arXiv id, arXiv: prefixed id, or https://arxiv.org/abs/ or /pdf/ URL in paper, optionally versioned. Listed papers return their reproduction result without external fetching. An unlisted id fetches public metadata for that id from arXiv, Hugging Face and GitHub; no caller information is forwarded. The code link's origin is stated and unverified. Returns sourced, dated code_facts, NOT a reproduction, plus the optional rerun request. Missing sources are explicit; never infer an outcome from these facts.

paper.description: Whole bare arXiv id, arXiv: prefixed id, or https://arxiv.org/abs/ or /pdf/ URL, optionally with vN; no DOI or title

name: paper_code_facts
title: Public repository facts for an arXiv paper
